name: Codemode
description: Run an async JavaScript body in QuickJS over authorized tools. Reuse known current contracts. searchTools(query, {limit?, namespace?}) returns compact tool summaries and producer namespaces; describeNamespace(name) lists a producer's tools; describeTool(name) returns full input/output schemas and a generated call declaration. ALL_TOOLS lists callable JavaScript names and summaries. Call tools.<name>(args) directly to receive its declared business result. Failed calls reject; successful empty collections remain valid. Await every call, inspect every rejection from Promise.allSettled, and sequence dependent operations and mutations. Pass only needed fields, sources, completeness and failures to text(value) or return. store(key,value)/load(key) persist small JSON values, resource references and cursors on this branch after success; full child results remain in Artifacts. image({data,mimeType}) emits an image block. External work uses authorized tools with normal approvals, cancellation and scheduling; the VM has no Node, imports, filesystem, network or timers. The callable catalog is fixed for this script. Interactive and inference-control tools must be called directly. A failed script retains partial output and call statuses; read completed results before repeating effects, which are not rolled back.

code.description: Async JavaScript function body; top-level await and return are supported.
